source: argparse parser of openadapt-flow 2.1.0 from PyPI (openadapt_flow.__main__.build_parser), long options only. Written by scripts/flow_cli_reference.py snapshot.

help.admit: Read the published release-admission ledger. Does not sign or issue an admission.
help.admit status: Print admitted vs not-admitted for Flow from the public ledger. Never mints a signature.
help.approve: Record an authenticated approval (approver / resolution / bundle version) authorizing a durably-paused run to resume
help.approve-sanitized: Approve and freeze the exact reviewed derivative as an immutable archive
help.attach-seal: Attach Cloud's signed Execute receipt (the Seal) to a VERIFIED run report
help.bench: Replay a bundle N times against MockMed and aggregate
help.benchmark: Benchmark compiled replay vs. a Claude computer-use agent on the MockMed triage task (agent arm needs an Anthropic API key and costs real money)
help.bind-record-checks: Attach reviewed record checks (system-of-record effect contracts) to a compiled program's save step, in a new bundle; reports which entered fields they compare
help.business-decisions: Customer-runner typed-decision relay; it never resumes or acts.
help.certify: Enforce a policy on a bundle (exits nonzero + reports if it fails); passing means the bundle meets that policy's rules, not that it is safe to run
help.compile: Compile a recording into a workflow bundle
help.compose: Author a parent sequencer from named compiled child bundles and a handoff contract. Each child stays bound to its recorded surface. certify/run the output directory.
help.connect: Claim a one-time browser pairing and store the workspace credential in the OS keychain
help.connector: BYOC connector: enroll this machine with OpenAdapt Cloud and run governed jobs LOCALLY (customer owns the data boundary; PHI stays on this side)
help.connector enroll: Enroll against a mock/development control plane and persist its token
help.connector run: Poll the control plane and run governed jobs until interrupted
help.console: Serve the operator console: a localhost-only web UI over compiled bundles, run reports/halt evidence, and skill-library lineage. Read-only unless --allow-actions; needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[console]'`
help.demo: See the proof in one command: a checked run and a run where the app lies, side by side on one page (fake clinic data, no AI calls)
help.demo-record: Serve MockMed and record the canonical triage demo
help.disambiguate: Surface compile-time multiple-choice questions for an ambiguous demo and apply the answers as guards/params (ask, don't guess)
help.emit-mcp: Emit a standalone MCP server.py for a bundle
help.emit-skill: Emit an Agent Skills folder for a bundle
help.explain: Plain-language read of a completed run dir: what happened, why the outcome is the safe one, and the next suggested command (read-only)
help.for-each: Author a DATA-DRIVEN LOOP bundle: wrap an existing single-demonstration bundle's linear body in a LOOP that runs once per record of a worklist (CSV/JSON), binding each record's columns to the workflow's parameters. Emits a program:true bundle the runtime executes bounded, $0, identity-gated and effect-verified per record
help.induce: Induce a parameterized PROGRAM bundle from MULTIPLE recordings (multi-trace induction: infer params / loops / branches). REFUSES (nonzero exit, no bundle) when intent is underdetermined, printing a record-next worklist of missing demonstrations
help.intake: Fill a workflow's parameters from a referral PDF, fax image, or email
help.item-approval: List, approve or decline the per-item approval requests a run is waiting on (Desktop's Run it)
help.item-approval approve: Approve one save a person checked in Desktop's Run it
help.item-approval decline: Don't save: decline one save with a closed reason
help.item-approval show: Print the run's approval requests as JSON
help.lint: Report a bundle's coverage gaps (unarmed clicks, vacuous postconditions, under-classified risk); exits nonzero by severity
help.login: Validate an ingest token against the hosted control plane and store it in the OS keychain
help.materialize-approved: Rebuild an approved derivative from its archive and approval record
help.process: Author a ProcessContract parent from independently admitted capabilities. Each --child needs a --admission envelope. certify/run the output directory; replay refuses it.
help.propose-qualification: Draft a production-shaped qualification contract from a compiled demo. Alias of `qualify propose`.
help.push: Upload the exact approved sanitized archive to /api/ingest; raw input is sanitized locally and paused for review
help.qualify: Create, edit, test, explain, and certify the versioned qualification project sealed into a workflow bundle
help.qualify accept: Confirm every proposed pin in one command after the proposed oracle catches a --break-it fault. Refusing a pin HALTs.
help.qualify add-case: Add a representative or fault case
help.qualify add-requalification: Add a condition that requires this workflow to be requalified
help.qualify admit-local: Sign a local-dev admission for an accepted proposal. The signer cannot enter a production trust map.
help.qualify business-decision: Add, update, or inspect one reviewed finite business decision without editing the workflow manifest
help.qualify certify: Persist a combined qualification and existing-policy decision
help.qualify drills: Add the five readiness drills for the practice case's save and trust this computer's local drill key (a local campaign)
help.qualify from-demo: Propose pins from the demo, accept them, and optionally sign a local-dev admission. After record and compile.
help.qualify judgment-cases: Store or check reviewed local judgment cases; this command never synthesizes an executable rule from examples
help.qualify label: Optionally set, remove, or list presentation-only entity labels
help.qualify label set: Set an optional presentation label for one qualified step
help.qualify propose: Draft application, environment, identity, and effect pins from the compiled demo. Missing pins HALT; nothing is guessed. Runs the proposed oracle against a --break-it fault.
help.qualify run: Import case results produced by the Desktop/local/customer-controlled qualification runner
help.qualify run-case: Run one current qualification case (the practice item or a readiness drill) with Flow-owned Standard authorization
help.qualify set-effect: Assign verification-strength tier to an existing effect
help.qualify set-identity: Set exact/normalized identity fields and their quorum
help.qualify set-risk: Confirm an action's reviewed business-risk classification
help.qualify trust-runner: Trust an Ed25519 qualification-runner public key
help.record: Record YOUR workflow interactively: a headed browser (--backend web --url), or the operator's real local desktop input through openadapt-capture (--backend windows/macos/linux/rdp/citrix)
help.repair: Governed repair promotion lifecycle: register a proposed (healed or taught) bundle as a CANDIDATE, review its diff, run the replay and fault campaigns, approve (human), stage, canary, and roll back. A proposed bundle NEVER becomes active without this lifecycle. See docs/REPAIR_LIFECYCLE.md
help.repair approve: HUMAN approval gating promotion; refuses unless the diff was reviewed and BOTH campaigns passed. Binds the exact bundle hashes
help.repair campaign: Run a campaign against the candidate's evidence frames: 'replay' (healthy drift battery must all pass) or 'fault' (ambiguity / wrong-entity / stale-target / dialog / verifier-failure frames must all be REFUSED)
help.repair canary: Atomically activate the staged bundle in CANARY mode: a bounded first-N-runs window with per-run verification before full active
help.repair canary-record: Record one canary run from its run directory; any silent-incorrect or verification regression auto-reverts to the prior bundle
help.repair list: List candidates and their lifecycle states
help.repair register: Register a (prior, proposed) bundle pair as a repair candidate; refuses (fail closed) any contract weakening without a new qualification revision
help.repair review: Record a human review of the candidate's diff
help.repair rollback: One-command rollback: restore the prior bundle hash as the active pointer
help.repair show: Show a candidate's reviewable diff, campaigns, and state
help.repair stage: Copy BOTH bundles into the store by content hash and re-verify them byte-exact (prior too, so rollback is always local)
help.repair status: Show the atomic active-bundle pointer and its lineage
help.replay: Replay a bundle (serves the bundled MockMed demo app when no --url is given)
help.report-break: Emit a PHI-free break diagnostic from a halted run's report.json to /api/runs/ingest-report (the recording stays local)
help.report-run: Emit a PHI-free SUCCESS summary from a completed run's report.json to /api/runs/ingest-report (bounded counts, duration, and exact pushed-bundle identity — the recording stays local)
help.resume: Resume a durably-paused run from its last verified checkpoint (never re-running an already-confirmed write)
help.review-sanitized: Review original vs sanitized content in a loopback-only local viewer
help.run: Execute a bundle under a deployment config (--config): the replay path wired for a real deployment (backend / effects / actuation / durable / policy) instead of the demo
help.sanitize: Create a verified PHI-scrubbed derivative without modifying the original
help.scaffold-verifier: Draft an effect-oracle contract (effect_contract.yaml) from a recording or bundle's write-shaped steps. The output is a DRAFT requiring human edit; refuses demonstrations with no consequential (write) step
help.seal: Copy a bundle to a new path, encrypt its workflow and template evidence with OPENADAPT_BUNDLE_KEY, verify integrity, and publish it atomically
help.serve-execute: Host the public Execute v1 HTTP+MCP contract locally. Receipts are self-signed with a local key. They are not OpenAdapt production Seals. Needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[execute]'`
help.serve-reward: Score training episodes by reading the system of record through an independent oracle. Receipts are self-signed reward receipts, not Execute Seals. Needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[reward]'`
help.teach: Self-serve HALT -> LEARN: resolve a halted run from a fix demonstration. Induces the correction as a guarded exception branch, gates + validates it, and writes an updated bundle ONLY if it passes (governed refusal otherwise; nonzero exit)
help.teach-branch: Learn a guarded branch from two or more halts resolved the same way. The branch keys on the screen text they share (narrowed by an enum parameter when normal runs show that text too) and is written as a repair candidate that needs approval
help.tutorial: Run the bundled tutorial end to end against a real local system of record: record, compile, certify, govern, and VERIFY the write out of band, then write a shareable local receipt
help.validate-hosted: Bind strict lint, policy certification, and a successful local replay to an expiring Cloud challenge and exact approved artifacts. Standard and Regulated activation also binds the sealed governed authorization template.
help.visualize: See what a demonstration compiled INTO: emit a program-graph view of a bundle or a composed parent (child bundles, --after DAG, effect-bound handoffs) as self-contained HTML, Mermaid, or the shared JSON graph spec
